item.title: Potholes here are making a dangerous loose surface for Motorcyclist's, 15th August
item.description:
The whole of the Rowanfield Road is covered in gravel. It's extremely dangerous for Motorcyclist's, who are more than 100 times more vulnerable than drivers, and more than 4 times more vulnerable than cyclists travelling over the same surface. As a Motorcyclist, I'm asking that you please sweep the road ASAP to reduce this risk to me and others, until you are able to make good the potholes which are creating this gravel.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10, Rowanfield Road, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Blocked road gully, 15th August
item.description:
In october 2025 I reported the gully outside 5 Horsefair Street as being blocked. I was told it would be cleared in the December cycle of cleaning, it was not cleared and remains completely blocked. At the same time I reported that the kerb in the same location was damaged by increased traffic, you replied that it was not of concern.. It is now starting to break up with several chunks of concrete now broken off.

item.title: Pavement worn away, 15th August
item.description:
On the corner of Noverton Avenue and Noverton Lane the pavement cannot be walked on as the overhanging prickly bush has forced people to walk on the grass verge which has subsequently worn away. Despite previous reports saying it’s been dealt with, it definitively hasn’t and needs to be done before any wet weather makes it worse. There are nearby residents who use walking aids so it must be a hazard for them.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 35, Noverton Lane, Noverton, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
